purpose: Per CEO R292 P5: 'Produce a standard Buyer Evaluation Kit reusable across all 15 candidates. A buyer response should automatically create a new machine event: BUYER_FEEDBACK → REQUIREMENT → TEST → RESULT → TTP_UPDATE.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXVI (no self-certification — buyer is independent verifier). Article XXXV (closed-loop epistemic control — buyer feedback enters the loop).

kit_components.description: Single-page summary: mechanism name, what it does, why it matters, what is known, what is hypothesized, what the buyer can test
kit_components.template: P-01 uses COMMERCIAL_TTP_R289.md (3-box structure). Same template for all 15.

kit_components.description: 15-element Technology Transfer Package with status labels (VERIFIED/EXTERNAL_SOURCE/MODELLED/HYPOTHESIS/BUYER_UNVERIFIED/MISSING)
kit_components.template: P-01_FULL_TTP.json is the reference. Same 15-element structure for all 15.

kit_components.description: Honest disclosure of what is NOT proven, what is NOT validated, what the known weaknesses are
kit_components.template: P-01: multi_failure catastrophic (69.8 mmHg), sensor_dropout was weakness (fixed in V2.1), model-only evidence (not clinical). Each package has its own limitations.

kit_components.description: Blinded, randomized test protocol designed to FALSIFY the computational result
kit_components.template: P-01: 80-run blinded B-vs-V2.1 protocol. Each package has its own protocol scaled to its evidence level.

kit_components.description: JSON schema for how the buyer submits test results back to us
kit_components.template: P-01: result_submission_schema.json (from R281 EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_HANDOFF). Same schema structure for all 15.

kit_components.description: Structured form for buyer to provide feedback (8 categories from BUYER_FEEDBACK_INTAKE_SCHEMA.json)
8 questions (Q-01 to Q-08) that convert MODELLED economics into BUYER_VERIFIED economics
kit_components.template: BUYER_ECONOMIC_QUESTIONNAIRE_TEMPLATE.json (from R277). Same 8 questions for all 15, with package-specific context.

kit_components.description: Honest prior-art landscape + claim language + what we believe is distinctive + where counsel should investigate. NOT a patent opinion — a technology-transfer disclosure.
kit_components.template: P-01: PRIOR_ART_LANDSCAPE_R287.json + FROZEN_MECHANISM_R287.md (5 claims). Each package has its own landscape.

kit_components.description: How the package updates based on buyer feedback. BUYER_FEEDBACK → REQUIREMENT → TEST → RESULT → TTP_UPDATE → VERSION_2
kit_components.template: Evidence loop state machine (from R277, updated R282). Buyer feedback enters via BUYER_FEEDBACK_INTAKE_SCHEMA → creates new test case → runs test → if fail, creates design change → re-verifies → updates TTP.

the_automatic_loop.trigger: Buyer responds (positive, negative, or with objections)
the_automatic_loop.machine_action: BUYER_FEEDBACK_INTAKE_SCHEMA categorizes the response → if it reveals a new requirement, creates a TEST CASE → runs test (computational or physical) → produces EVIDENCE RECORD (with FDA PCLC metrics + 5-category failure classification) → if test fails, creates ENGINEERING CHANGE REQUEST → re-verifies → updates TTP → new VERSION → re-sends to buyer
the_automatic_loop.the_loop: BUYER_FEEDBACK → REQUIREMENT → TEST → RESULT → TTP_UPDATE → VERSION_2 → BUYER_RE_EVALUATION
the_automatic_loop.example: Buyer says: 'Your controller doesn't handle posture changes.' → Machine creates 'posture_change' attack mode → runs V2.1 under posture_change → if V2.1 fails → creates V2.2 design requirement (add posture compensation) → re-verifies → updates TTP → notifies buyer: 'We tested your concern. V2.1 failed under posture change. V2.2 addresses this. Here is the new evidence.'

what_makes_this_different_from_a_sales_d.sales_deck: Claims the technology works. Hides weaknesses. Asks buyer to believe.
what_makes_this_different_from_a_sales_d.buyer_evaluation_kit: Shows what is known (225-run ablation). Shows what is hypothesized (physical bench will reproduce 2-3x). Shows what is NOT proven (no physical evidence, no clinical evidence). Shows the known weakness (multi_failure catastrophic). Gives buyer a protocol designed to BREAK the result. Asks buyer to TEST, not believe. Buyer's objection becomes the next experiment.
